{{For|[[Ginger Island]]|Ginger Island#Dig Site|R=This article is about the [[Pelican Town]] quarry.}} The '''Quarry''' consists of a large area with a wide selection of rocks and [[Mining#Mining Nodes|mining nodes]] that are randomly generated. Each day there is a chance that new rocks and nodes as well as [[Trees|oak and maple tree]] seeds will be generated. It is part of the same map as [[the Mountain]], therefore it has the same [[Foraging#Foraged Items|forageable]] items and [[Artifact Spot]] contents as the Mountain. The Quarry is unlocked by completing the [[Bundles#Crafts Room|Crafts Room bundles]] in the [[Community Center]] or by purchasing "Bridge" from the [[Joja Community Development Form]] for {{Price|25000}}. There will be a cut scene that night where the bridge is repaired. The Quarry itself can be home to every ore and gem in the game. However, stones containing valuable items like [[Iridium Ore]] or [[Prismatic Shard]]s are much rarer and the player may have to wait several seasons for new ones to spawn. The Entrance to the [[Quarry Mine]] is on the western side of the quarry, above the bridge. The [[Minecart]] can also take the player to the Quarry once the bridge is repaired. (The Minecart is unlocked by either completing the [[Bundles#Boiler Room|Boiler Room bundles]] or by purchasing "Minecarts" from the [[Joja Community Development Form]] at [[JojaMart]] for {{Price|15000}}.) ==Spawning== Each day new rocks, nodes, oak and maple seeds will spawn. In year 1, the game attempts to add 7 things from the table below. This increases by 2 each year up to a maximum of 16. Colored tiles (yellow or blue) can be used to place [[Crafting#Decor|paths]], [[Crafting#Artisan Equipment|artisan equipment]] and [[Crafting#Refining Equipment|refining equipment]]. Yellow tiles (tillables) may also be used to plant [[Trees|common trees]]. [[Villagers]] do not travel through the Quarry or on its bridge, so items placed there are safe from destruction. {{clear}} ==Gallery== Quarry.png|The Quarry in Spring Mystic Stone.png|A Mystic Stone found in the Quarry Iridum ore mined.png|Upon mining a Mystic Stone ==References== See Mountain::quarryDayUpdate in the game code. ==History== {{History|1.4|Bombs no longer cause ore nodes to drop stone.
